# Example Project — Product Requirements

A minimal frozen product intent used only as migration source evidence: a small tool
whose baseline epic and Task short ID are reused across two releases, with authored
audit and defect history attached.

## Vision

Ship the shared baseline in v1, then extend it in v1.1 under the same epic and Task
short ID while keeping the audit register and defect history intact and interpretable.
